children: UBS (CH:UBSG), Deutsche Bank (XE:DBK), UniCredit (IT:UCG): Shares of European banks retreated as global bond yields continued to push higher, in a sign that investors are growing increasingly worried that higher borrowing costs could lead to more loan defaults.
Dave & Buster's Entertainment (PLAY): The arcade chain swung to a loss in the most recent quarter as it struggles to regain relevancy with customers. Shares tumbled 12%.

Coinbase Global (COIN), Robinhood Markets (HOOD), Strategy (MSTR): Shares of companies tied to cryptocurrencies slid alongside the price of bitcoin. The cryptocurrency recently traded around $76,800, down nearly 3% from its 4 p.m. ET price Monday.
Halliburton (HAL), Occidental Petroleum (OXY), Marathon Petroleum (MPC): Shares of energy companies advanced as Brent crude oil prices rose.
Crowdstrike (CRWD): Concerns about AI safety buoyued the cybersecurity company. The stock, the S&P 500's top performer Monday, edged higher in early trading.
